items.summary:
This isn’t what I had in mind when I asked someone to capture a flag… can you help? You should check out Wireshark.
TL;DR A CAPture of a Flag is a foundational network forensics challenge involving packet capture analysis. By following HTTP TCP streams in Wireshark, we locate an unencrypted HTTP GET request carrying a base64-encoded parameter ( msg=ZmxhZ3tBRmxhZ0luUENBUH0= ).
